guideUpdate.title: Cancel an edited Surveyor configuration without applying it
guideUpdate.affectedSection: Opening and cancelling Surveyor configuration in V4 GIS
steps: In the GIS layer catalogue, select the Surveyor configuration control to open its configuration dialog.
Enter the required value in Username if you want to edit the configuration.
Select Cancel to discard the edit and return to GIS without adding a Surveyor layer.
To open the configuration again, select the Surveyor configuration control once more.
Confirm that Username is empty when the dialog reopens, then select Cancel to return to GIS with the existing map and layer state unchanged.
screenshotCaptions: The Surveyor configuration dialog visibly contains TEST2-cancel-check in Username before cancellation.
After cancelling the edited dialog, GIS shows the unchanged map and Map layers state with no Surveyor layer added.
Surveyor configuration has reopened with an empty Username field and Cancel and Add layer controls available.
After cancelling again, GIS retains the original map and Map layers state without a Surveyor layer.
guideUpdate.reason: Amends the existing Surveyor instructions to explain discarding an entered Username, the empty Username shown on reopening, and preservation of the existing GIS map and layer state.
